 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Deepak Kumar Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Abhay Kumar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
3 08-05-2025

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner who happens to be husband of the O.P. No.2 is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1400 of 2023, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offence punishable under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the O.P. No.2 in the year 2022.
However, on account of some differences between the parties and a family feud, the present complaint case has been filed.

Bona fide of the petitioner is also writ large for the fact that he has also filed a petition under Section 9 of Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.87224 of 2024(3) dt.08-05-2025 the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights,
which is pending in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna.

entities.text: Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner has also been ready to keep the O.P. No.2 as his wife with full honour and dignity.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 submitted that the O.P. No.2 is also ready to live with the petitioner if he mends his ways.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the submissions made on behalf of the parties, let the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation & Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The parties are directed to appear before the Mediation Centre on 14.05.2025 along with order of this Court and the relevant documents.
6. Upon appearance of the parties, the learned Mediator shall take all endeavours to reconcile the matter and come to an amicable settlement.

7. Re-notify this case on 19.06.2025 along with the report of the learned Mediator.
8.
In the meantime, interim protection as granted by this Court to the petitioner vide order dated 19.12.2024 shall remain continued.

(Harish Kumar, J) rohit/-
